scenicChapters.title: Chapmans Peak Drive
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 53 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 39 km this is Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-church-of-the-holy-archangels-gro.story: 302 km from Șurdești to Șurdești, about 5 h 12 of riding. It goes by way of Church of the Holy Parasceve, Kuziy - Trybushany, Church of Saint Nicholas and Groșii Țibleșului - Preluci. It crosses from Romania into Ukraine - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
